resources.string: Slide down to lock / unlock native hold speed

During a native left/right edge hold-to-speed gesture, slide down past its threshold and release to toggle its speed lock. Move back before release to cancel. If TikTok provides no usable threshold, this option uses 72dp locally.

Only works where TikTok already permits native edge hold-to-speed. On first enable, re-enter the video. Normal swipes and comment controls stay native. Multi-touch, cancellation, video rebind and pause withdraw the pending toggle. Turning this option off does not reset a speed already committed through TikTok.
